title: Line Shaders
description: Line Shaders is a lightweight Minecraft shader focused on smooth gameplay
body:
### ABOUT

- Line Shaders is a performance-focused Minecraft shader designed for players who want better visuals without sacrificing FPS. It enhances the game with soft lighting, subtle shadows, gentle bloom effects, and smooth waving water while keeping resource usage extremely low.

- Unlike heavy shaders, Line Shaders keeps everything simple and optimized, making it perfect for low-end and mid-range systems. The shader improves the overall look of Minecraft without overloading your GPU, ensuring stable and high frame rates even during intense gameplay.
